title: Hide other studies from study-job snapshots; hidden dirs land unchanged
summary: Retry of job 20261017-205554-zaj2 (produced no change because the systems schema is absent), narrowed as its introspection proposed: study jobs must see only the study they name. Hermes Agent and athena.toml are left to a separate follow-up job. Audience: the owner enforcing BRIEF.md Part 2 S1 fresh-context separation.

defaults_applied.how: Tests plus clippy and fmt criteria.
Split off the Hermes/config change into a follow-up job.
Criteria run cargo test on observable snapshot contents.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Previous result, job 20261017-205554-zaj2: it failed with no change because the base lacks the systems schema (no systems map under crates/; only a single repo_url/repo_ref on [capabilities.study]). This retry drops the Hermes/systems part, so that finding no longer applies; the new request adds no schema and selects the studied system by an id supplied to the snapshot code. That job's candidate changed no files, so there is no work to keep or drop.

Code survey: crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs (Snapshot::create hides records/ and athena-exclude paths; change_list, restore_to, materialize, copy_files, and the unit tests at the bottom), crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs and run/verification.rs (where snapshots are created for producer and verifier), crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs (reader snapshot), crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs (fake-driver run tests). No new record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file/AnyRecord are unaffected. The property is measured directly by listing the snapshot directory on disk and by byte-comparing the user repository's file after landing.

The studies in the tests are fixtures: the tests create a studies directory with two study directories named a and b inside a temporary test repository. They do not exist in this repository and this change does not add them. Only the test repository has them.
The study job's named system id is taken from the job's study system, defaulting to what the study capability already records; if no system id is known, nothing is hidden.
Governance: athena.toml is deliberately not changed; Hermes Agent as a second system is a separate follow-up job. Consumers: none found (no config deliverable).

acceptance_criteria.text: Run cargo test: a snapshot test builds a temporary repository with two study directories (fixtures a and b under studies/, created by the test) and shows that the reader, producer and verifier snapshots of a study job naming b contain b and not a, while a change job's snapshots contain both.

Run cargo test: a test shows a hidden study directory is never reported as deleted by the snapshot's change_list, and after a fake-driver study job naming b runs to landing, the fixture a files in the test repository are byte-identical to before.
CHANGELOG.md has a new entry describing study snapshot isolation and the hidden-directory landing rule; the diff shows it.
Run cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo fmt --all --check: both are clean, and cargo test passes.
The diff does not touch athena.toml or any studies/ file in this repository; Hermes Agent is not configured. Check with git diff.
The change refuses no readings; it only hides paths from study snapshots (expected 0% of newly refused readings).

out_of_scope: Adding the systems schema or the Hermes Agent entry; changing athena.toml (separate follow-up job)
Running or studying Hermes Agent, or writing a hermes-agent study
Changing the firstmate configuration or its existing study

Files from job 20261017-205554-zaj2 that its plan listed but this job does not need: crates/athena-core/src/run/pin.rs, crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs, crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs, athena.toml (dropped; that job's candidate had no changes)
departures: Slightly lower verification pass odds: the change touches snapshot, landing and three agent roles, and the earlier attempt failed.
hard_reason: Changes what snapshots show agents and how hidden paths are counted at landing, which is part of the run pipeline and landing rules.
